decision: Same persisted data contract; no migration or automatic metadata restore.
sourceReview: Document schema, resource paths, engine version and atomic commit protocol are unchanged.
The optional SDK image fileSize is validated before saving, then omitted from the durable scene so older strict readers accept it. Actual resource byte limits remain enforced.
Save still validates before committing and retains optimistic-concurrency checks. Normalization does not discard unknown fields or bypass their rejection.
Recovery export is an explicit external ZIP. It cannot overwrite a path inside the live canvas store and does not alter the committed document.

verified: Old image canvas loads unchanged in the candidate.
Candidate adds an SDK-style image carrying fileSize and saves an old-reader-compatible scene.
Real old binary reads both image resources, edits geometry and title, then copies the project.
Candidate reads the rollback edits and the copied project; final save/reopen preserves every image SHA-256 and resource identity.
Library rows and schema, categories, originals, pins, settings and nondefault storage paths survive all four phases.

existingRollbackLimitation: An old 0.1.33 settings save drops the newer IncludePreviewUpdates key; re-upgrade restores its default true. All prior keys and paths are preserved.
